description: Walk one evidence-bearing hop from a node after investigate or an incident card points to a locus. "up" finds callers/dependents and "down" finds callees/dependencies; each neighbor is classified primary-failure, symptom-only, or unrelated so you can separate cause from downstream symptoms.

direction.description: up = callers/dependents (toward the cause), down = callees/dependencies

nodeId.description: Graph node id to step from

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: expand
